# 好 + Adjective · *hou2 + Adjective*

**Meaning:** very · **Level:** A1 · **Topic:** Degree and comparison

> ⚠️ **Draft — awaiting native-speaker review.** Spotted something unnatural? Please [open an issue](https://github.com/jyltsang/cantonlink-community/issues/new).

Adjectives work like verbs, so no 係 is needed. A bare adjective can sound incomplete or comparative, so 好 is added by default — it often means just 'is' rather than a strong 'very'.

**Written Chinese:** 很 — Written Chinese uses 很; in speech say 好.

## Examples

| | |
|---|---|
| 漢字 | **今日好熱。** |
| Jyutping | gam1 jat6 hou2 jit6. |
| Yale | gām yaht hóu yiht. |
| Bopomofo | ㄍㄜㆬ¹ ㄧㄜㆵ⁶ ㄏㄛㄨ² ㄧㆵ⁶. |
| English | It's very hot today. |

| | |
|---|---|
| 漢字 | **呢度啲嘢好貴。** |
| Jyutping | ni1 dou6 di1 je5 hou2 gwai3. |
| Yale | nī douh dī yéh hóu gwai. |
| Bopomofo | ㄋㄧ¹ ㄉㄛㄨ⁶ ㄉㄧ¹ ㄧㄝ⁵ ㄏㄛㄨ² ㄍㄨㄜㄧ³. |
| English | Things here are very expensive. |

| | |
|---|---|
| 漢字 | **我好攰。** |
| Jyutping | ngo5 hou2 gui6. |
| Yale | ngóh hóu guih. |
| Bopomofo | ㆭㄛ⁵ ㄏㄛㄨ² ㄍㄨㄧ⁶. |
| English | I'm really tired. |

## Common mistakes

- ✗ ~~很好~~ → ✓ **好好** *hou2 hou2* · *hóu hóu*  
  很 is written Chinese. 'Very good' is 好好.
